title: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 1 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do) The following parcels of land in Iljik-dong, Gwangmyeong-si, Gyeonggi-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Gwangmyeong-si, Gyeonggi-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do: Lot 291-4, Lot 293-1, Lot 424-3, Lot 425-3, Lot 428-1, Lot 430-1, Lot 430-2, Lot 433-136, Lot 435, Lot 435-2, Lot 436-29, Lot 437-3, Lot 437-25, Lot 438-5, Lot 516, Lot 516-1, Lot 516-2, and Lots 516-6 through 516-9.
